about: Limits for scripts/asset-budget.mjs (npm run assets:budget), in bytes of JavaScript as written to dist/. Each is about 7% above what feat/route-code-splitting measured at e728bb7 on 2026-09-24; largestLazyRaw is about 10% above, because that chunk is Guided Setup, which another branch is rewriting. Raising a limit is allowed: say what grew and why in the commit.
